basis: Beta v5 I. Italy's Comtrade 2022 RX share for gas is 0, so the joint balance lifted its 0.19 bcm of IEA exports to all of production (3.06 bcm): ITA to CHE 2.0 and to AUT 0.7 bn are 2022 reverse-flow and transit gas, not Italian output. The same-propensity rule of GTAP 12 ch.12 §12.2.5 keeps domestic exports near the IEA volume and treats the rest as re-exports.
